backpack_small.name: Backpack (Small)
backpack_small.shortDescription: A compact, well-worn backpack with reinforced stitching. Lightweight but roomy enough for essential supplies.

backpack_medium_military.name: Backpack (Army-Issue)
backpack_medium_military.shortDescription: A heavy duty backpack designed for military use. The fabric are very durable and some soldier wear it in the front to use it as additional armor when in battle.

backpack_large_military.name: Large Military Backpack
backpack_large_military.shortDescription: A heavy duty backpack designed for military use. The fabric are very durable and some soldier wear it in the front to use it as additional armor when in battle.

sec_box.name: Security Department Supply Crate
sec_box.shortDescription: A locked crate. Labeled for the Station Security Armory. Full of supplies. Access card required.

evidence_box.name: Security Department Evidence Locker
evidence_box.shortDescription: A locked crate. Labeled for the Station Security Evidence Locker. Valuable. Access card required.
evidence_box.flavorText: There's enough here to put the entire Lower Levels behind bars.

med_box.name: Medical Bay Supply Crate
med_box.shortDescription: A locked crate. Labeled for the Station Medical Bay. Full of supplies. Access card required.
med_box.flavorText: Surely these missing supplies won't cost anyone their lives... right?

eng_box.name: Engineering Foundry Supply Crate
eng_box.shortDescription: A locked crate. Labeled for the Station Engineering Foundry. Full of supplies. Access card required.
eng_box.flavorText: Those hard hats will regret losing their tools...

service_box.name: Service Department Supply Crate
service_box.shortDescription: A secure crate. Labeled for the Station Service Department. Full of supplies. Access card required.
service_box.flavorText: The Station Service Department distributes utility supplies to those who need, or pay, for them.

luxury_supply_crate.name: Care Package for Eleanor
luxury_supply_crate.shortDescription: A sealed crate of fine goods from the Upper Levels. Whoever packed it spared no expense. Strange, though: your Security feed lists it as reported stolen.
